name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_finding_of_autosomal_dominant_late_onset_parkinson_disease_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has an autosomal dominant late-onset form of Parkinson's disease.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has an autosomal dominant late-onset form of Parkinson's disease.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have an autosomal dominant late-onset form of Parkinson's disease.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has an autosomal dominant late-onset form of Parkinson's disease.

name: patient_has_finding_of_autosomal_dominant_late_onset_parkinson_disease_now@@apparently_being_inherited_in_the_patients_family
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's autosomal dominant late-onset Parkinson's disease is apparently being inherited in the patient's family.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's autosomal dominant late-onset Parkinson's disease is apparently being inherited in the patient's family.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's autosomal dominant late-onset Parkinson's disease is not apparently being inherited in the patient's family.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's autosomal dominant late-onset Parkinson's disease is apparently being inherited in the patient's family.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_parkinson_s_disease_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_parkinson_s_disease_now@@supported_by_tremor_bradykinesia_and_responsiveness_to_levodopa
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current diagnosis of Parkinson's disease is supported by the presence of tremor, bradykinesia, and responsiveness to levodopa.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current diagnosis of Parkinson's disease is supported by the presence of all three clinical criteria: tremor, bradykinesia, and responsiveness to levodopa.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current diagnosis of Parkinson's disease is not supported by all three criteria.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the diagnosis is supported by all three criteria.

name: patient_has_finding_of_tremor_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of tremor.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of tremor.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of tremor.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of tremor.

name: patient_has_finding_of_bradykinesia_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of bradykinesia.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of bradykinesia.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of bradykinesia.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of bradykinesia.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_levodopa_now@@responsiveness
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently exposed to levodopa and demonstrates clinical responsiveness to levodopa.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently exposed to levodopa and demonstrates clinical responsiveness to levodopa.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently exposed to levodopa but does not demonstrate responsiveness, or if responsiveness is absent.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient demonstrates responsiveness to levodopa.

name: patient_has_finding_of_dementia_associated_with_parkinson_s_disease_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has Parkinson's disease associated with dementia.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of Parkinson's disease associated with dementia.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of Parkinson's disease associated with dementia.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of Parkinson's disease associated with dementia.

name: patient_has_finding_of_autosomal_dominant_late_onset_parkinson_disease_now@@apparently_being_inherited_in_the_family
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's autosomal dominant form of Parkinson's disease is apparently being inherited in the family.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's autosomal dominant form of Parkinson's disease is apparently being inherited in the family.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's autosomal dominant form of Parkinson's disease is not apparently being inherited in the family.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's autosomal dominant form of Parkinson's disease is apparently being inherited in the family.

name: patient_is_unaffected_member_of_family
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is an unaffected member of a family.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is a member of a family and is unaffected by the disease or condition of interest present in the family.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is a member of a family and is affected by the disease or condition of interest present in the family, or if the patient is not a member of a family.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is an unaffected member of a family.
